scope: Read-only review of branch endpoint inclusion, factory q versus profile x variables, and nominal versus explicit-override source call paths. No CAD or ContactProfile import/evaluation, actual pose q recomputation, motion/force experiment or new allowed-domain computation.

positive_q_branch_endpoint_review.zero_endpoint: q=0 belongs to plateau in the full source domain; it is excluded from the positive-q notation only.

coordinate_review.four_original_pin_q_values: The appendix retains four original pin_q values equal to 0; this review did not rerun profile construction.

call_path_review.zero_dq_dx_and_unspecified_telescope: native_scene first obtains the endpoint scene; endpoint -> serviceable -> pawl -> cam.scene supplies the nominal STOP/SPRING mapping. The per-side override does not execute for allocation None and zero dq and dx.
call_path_review.override_condition: allocations[side] is not None or dq or dx
call_path_review.override_reuses_same_q: The per-side override uses q=K*slide+dq for each ContactProfile and computes the same source height difference relative to q=0.
call_path_review.STOP_source_mapping: delta = profile.evaluate(q)[0] - profile.evaluate(0)[0]; translation X = sign*delta, with sign -1 for L and +1 for R.
call_path_review.SPRING_source_mapping: Original X bounds are expanded using min(0,sign*delta) and max(0,sign*delta), then a radius 0.43 cylinder is constructed along +X at the original Y/Z centre. This is the named OD tolerance envelope.

not_certified_by_this_review: contact stability or loss of contact
